blurb: AK Fishing Adventures offers guided fishing trips targeting species like Rainbow Trout, landlocked Salmon, King Salmon, Coho Salmon, Sockeye Salmon, Steelhead Trout, Lake Trout, and Pike. Trips are available on local lakes, Kenai River, Kasilof River, and for ice fishing. Trips vary in duration and group size, with options for half-day, full-day, and multi-day excursions.
